title: The Forbidden Question Box
hook: Chance draws. A pass finishes the turn.
steps: Name what is off tonight. Use these slips or write originals. Each privately keeps three, folded, initial on the outside.
Coin for the first draw, then alternate. Answer and say "that's the answer," pass, or, if the initial is theirs, "This one is yours. Do you want it?"
They answer, pass, or tear it unread. Your own slip cannot be offered back. Two draws finish. "Close the box" may end it sooner.
bank: Which compliment do you trust least?
What harmless hill are you still willing to die on?
What small luxury feels like too much to want out loud?
What do you know how to do that almost never comes up?
Where does your ambition get shy?
What food do you want praised for, as if you invented it?
What are you tired of being good at?
What do you hope I have already noticed, without a hint?
ending: Tear the unread slips, or return them by initial. Do not peek.
pass: The listener says "Passed." No groan and no bargain. A pass is complete.
safety: Tear a slip that asks for harm, an illness, or a third person's secret. An answer is not consent.

title: The Moral Gray Area
hook: Two live costs, and no answer key.
steps: Read one scene. A veto retires it. Take the other, or stop. A coin picks the opener.
Two quiet minutes. Write the values that collide and the cost of each path.
Opener, up to 3 minutes. "I do not land" counts. Listener, one sentence only: "The collision I heard was ___ and ___." Do not grade.
The other speaks up to 3 minutes. Reflect them the same way. Each says, "What I want you to know about how I decide is ___." If apart, "We landed differently." No rebuttal.
bank: Three nights. A piece of work would fund a dream you have named for years. It would also take you out three nights a week for a year. Yes funds the dream and spends the evenings. No keeps the evenings and leaves the dream unfunded. The other person in your home is allowed to be unhappy either way. There is no villain in the house.

The incomplete refund. A product failed in a way that matches the refund policy. You also caused part of the failure. You can describe the defect that happened and leave your part out. The money matters. A complete account may mean no refund.
ending: One scene is finished, even if you landed apart.
pass: Retire the card, or pass the scene, without naming the nerve.
safety: Not a current wound, not last Thursday, and not physical danger. Disagreement can stand.

title: The Unpopular Opinion Club
hook: One view you usually sand down. Then stop.
steps: Body, identity, family, faith, or trauma may be named off. No demeaning view. No grievance about your partner. No take chosen for heat.
Each writes the opinion in one or two sentences, and why it matters. The author reads for about 3 minutes, then stops.
The listener asks two questions, one at a time. Then four sentences of a different view, or what you understand if you share it. The stack stops.
One quiet minute. The other opinion is not a reply.
bank: What does this protect?
When did you start keeping it small?
What would it change for you if I understood it and still disagreed?
ending: Each listener names one thing now understood that was not clear an hour ago. You may still disagree.
pass: Pause, pass, or trade it for a milder opinion.
safety: If it is a complaint about the listener, name that and save it for a direct request another day.

title: The Question Behind the Question
hook: Start ordinary. Follow one step at a time.
steps: One or two true, mundane sentences: the day, lunch, or what you look forward to.
Ask one direction. Reflect a little content and a little feeling. Ask, "Is that close?" They correct you or let it stand. Do not argue with the correction.
Another question only if they want it. Four is the ceiling. Stop if they stop, the answers repeat, or you steer.
They have the last word on the meaning. Switch to a different ordinary answer. Do not analyze their turn.
bank: What was good about it, or what did it cost?
What did it remind you of?
What did you want in that moment, and what did you not say?
What do you hope I understand, now that you've said this much?
ending: A corrected reflection worked. Do not fix the day unless they ask.
pass: Stop the ladder, rewrite a question, or park the meaning. Parked is not homework.
safety: If you are depleted, skip the card. Depth belongs to the speaker.

title: The Thing I'm Still Figuring Out
hook: A question you cannot honestly finish tonight.
steps: Each completes, "I am still figuring out ___." If you can answer it, choose another blank.
Optional, and skippable: what makes it alive, what you have tried, and which company helps.

No advice. Ask "What makes this alive right now?" only if they have not said, or they invite it. Asked-for silence lasts at least a minute. A story from your own unknown stays short, then hand the room back.
Switch. The second is not a reply and not a contest.
bank: Silence.
Curiosity.
A story from the listener's own unknown.
Simply being believed.
ending: Read both aloud as open items. Do not solve them. A later date is a revisit, not a deadline.
pass: Pass, pause, or choose a smaller unknown. They need not match in size.
safety: Do not make it a household plan. A crisis leaves the card. "You'll definitely be fine" shuts the door.
